item.title: Court dismisses defamation lawsuit of Pastor Micahn Carter against woman who accused him of rape
item.description: The Court of Appeals in Washington state has dismissed a defamation lawsuit filed by former megachurch pastor Micahn Carter against his former assistant, who alleges he raped her in her office at Together Church in Yakima in 2019. #PastorMicahnCarter #Defamation #Lawsuit #Washington #Assistant

item.title: Reformed convict asks why adult-themed books denied to Texas inmates are available in school libraries
item.description: Why are explicit books and other materials denied to prisoners available to children in school libraries? #Texas #SchoolLibraries #LGBT

item.title: 'A massive betrayal': Pro-lifers react to Trump's Hyde Amendment comments
item.description: Multiple pro-life activists and a Christian conservative leader are criticizing President Donald Trump for saying Tuesday that Republicans need to be “flexible” in their demands for stricter rules preventing tax dollars from being used to fund abortions through healthcare subsidies. #Trump #Abortion #HydeAmendment #Healthcare #AffordableCareAct #Evangelicals #Prolife

item.title: 3 teenagers among dozens killed during ongoing protests in Iran: report
item.description: Around three dozen people and three minors have been killed after more than a week of protests in Iran sparked by the country’s economic crisis, according to reports from human rights groups. #Iran #Iranprotests #humanrights #Iranianprotestors #securityforces

item.title: Colo. pays over $6M to settle legal challenge to abortion pill reversal ban
item.description: Colorado has agreed to pay more than $6 million in legal fees to settle litigation against a state law barring pro-life groups from providing the abortion pill reversal treatment for women seeking to save their babies' lives by stopping a chemically-induced miscarriage. #Colorado #abortion #abortionpill #abortionpillreversal #prolife #religiousliberty

item.title: 'Unfolding siege': Watchdog group sounds alarm as CCP authorities surround church
item.description: A watchdog group that monitors Christian persecution in China is pleading for international attention as Chinese Communist Party (CCP) authorities appear poised to destroy a prominent church in Wenzhou, a port and industrial city in China's Zhejiang province. #China #ChinaAid #BobFu #YayangChristianChurch #Zhejiang

item.title: Donnie McClurkin says he 'will be vindicated' after rape claims from former parishioner
item.description: Popular gospel singer and pastor Donnie McClurkin claimed recent claims of rape and sexual assault from a man who served as his personal assistant at his church are “contrived and untrue." Believing he “will be vindicated," he urged prayers for his accuser. #DonnieMcClurkin #Rape #SexualAssault #Gospel #Lawsuit #GiuseppeCorletto

item.title: Jamal Bryant slammed for buying wife flesh-colored gala dress: 'Lowering of standards'
item.description: Christian leaders and influencers are speaking out about the dress that megachurch Pastor Jamal Bryant bought for his wife to wear to a gala event last month, sparking debate about how Christians should present themselves in public. #PastorJamalBryant #pastorswife #churchministry #Christianliving

item.title: Philip Yancey admits extramarital affair, will step away from ministry work to focus on marriage
item.description: Philip Yancey has admitted to having an extramarital affair with a married woman for eight years, with the bestselling Christian author announcing that he's stepping away from ministry. #PhilipYancey #Yancey #ChristianityToday #adultery #sin #affair

item.title: Karoline Leavitt pledges 'all-hands-on-deck' approach to cracking down on state fraud
item.description: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt pledged during the first press briefing of the new year Wednesday that the Trump administration is taking an "all-hands-on-deck" approach to cracking down on alleged widespread fraud in states such as Minnesota. #WhiteHouse #KarolineLeavitt #Trumpadministration #Minnesota
